_comment: Picadillo, from Jonathan Zaragoza's video 'The Ground Beef Recipe Everyone Makes Differently'
(YouTube, recipe around 16:16). The owner pasted the ingredient list on 2026-10-05.
Every line gave grams first, so each cell is that gram figure. The volumes and prep notes
that followed have no place in a matrix cell, so they are kept here as the lines were given:
454 g (1 lb) ground beef
60 g (1/4 cup) neutral oil, plus more as needed
165 g (1 medium) white onion, small dice
20 g garlic, minced
125 g (1 medium) carrot, peeled and small dice
230 g (2 small) yukon gold potatoes, peeled and small dice
430 g roma tomatoes, chopped
20 g (1) ancho chile, stemmed and seeded
7 g (1) pasilla chile, stemmed and seeded
5 g (1) guajillo chile, stemmed and seeded
12 g (about 2 1/2 tsp) worcestershire sauce
35 g (about 1/4 cup) castelvetrano olives, pitted and chopped
2 fresh bay leaves
0.75 g (1/2 tsp) whole cumin seeds
0.5 g (1/2 tsp) mexican oregano
0.5 g (1/4 tsp) whole coriander seeds
0.3 g (1/8 tsp) ground allspice
1.4 g (1/4 tsp) ground canela
YouTube is not on data/sources/curated.json, so the import keeps this recipe PRIVATE.
